card.description:
***Who We Are:***

Xenon Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:XENE) is a neuroscience-focused biopharmaceutical company dedicated to drug discovery, clinical development, and commercialization of life-changing therapeutics for patients in need. We are looking for great people who thrive in a respectful, collaborative, inclusive, and productive culture to join the Xenon team.

***What We Do:***

We are advancing an exciting product pipeline to address indications with high unmet medical need, including epilepsy, depression and pain. Our Phase 3 azetukalner program represents the most advanced, clinically validated potassium channel modulator in late-stage clinical development for multiple indications. In March 2026, we announced positive topline data from our Phase 3 X-TOLE2 study of azetukalner in focal onset seizures (FOS), and we submitted a New Drug Application to the Food and Drug Administration in the third quarter of 2026. Our Phase 3 epilepsy program also includes a second FOS study, X-TOLE3, which would support regulatory submissions outside the U.S., and the X-ACKT study in primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures, which would support regulatory submissions for an additional epilepsy indication. We also have multiple Phase 3 azetukalner clinical trials underway in major depressive disorder (MDD) and bipolar depression (BPD), based on topline data from our Phase 2 X-NOVA clinical trial. In addition, we are proud of our strong heritage in human genetics, deep understanding of ion channel biology, and expertise in novel chemistries to enable potent, selective ion channel targeting. We continue to advance an early-stage pipeline of novel therapeutic candidates, including Phase 1 studies for XEN1701 and XEN1720 (targeting Nav1.7) and XEN1120 (targeting Kv7), which are being developed for pain. Backed by a strong balance sheet to support our growth plans, we continue to build a fully integrated, premier neuroscience company with strong discovery, clinical development, corporate, and commercial operations.

***About the Role:***

We are seeking a **Manager/Senior Manager, Global Quality Systems,** who will provide leadership and oversight across key Quality Management System (QMS) processes, including quality events, investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control. This role will serve as a key quality partner across GxP functions, helping to identify systemic issues, strengthen investigation practices, and drive sustainable, risk-based improvements that support compliance, inspection readiness, and operational excellence. The role will work closely with internal teams and external service providers across Xenon’s outsourced operating model to ensure the QMS remains effective, compliant, and inspection ready.

The ideal candidate will bring strong Quality Systems experience, broad GxP knowledge, and sound business judgment, with the ability to effectively challenge investigations, facilitate meaningful root cause analysis, and influence stakeholders across functions. The role will also support quality governance, QMS metrics and trending, change control review, and the continued optimization of electronic quality systems.

This position reports to the Associate Director, Quality Assurance, Systems and will be based out of Boston, MA, USA in our Needham office. This role is a hybrid position, requiring a minimum of two onsite days per week. The level of the position will be commensurate with the candidate’s education and industry experience.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Quality Systems & Governance**

 + Manage the oversight, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of GxP Quality Systems, including quality events, investigations, CAPA, change control, and associated governance processes.
 + Ensure consistent, risk-based practices for investigation, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change management, including review and approval of records and escalation of significant quality or compliance risks.
 + Monitor QMS performance through metrics, trending, CAPA effectiveness, and Quality Management Review reporting to identify systemic risks and drive continuous improvement.
* **Compliance, Inspection Readiness & eQMS**

 + Assess QMS processes and proposed changes for GxP, regulatory, validation, training, documentation, and data integrity considerations, maintaining alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and industry expectations.
 + Support the administration, optimization, validation, upgrades, and continuous improvement of the eQMS and associated procedures, guidance, and training.
 + Support regulatory inspections and internal and external audits, including inspection readiness and responses to observations and findings.
* **Quality Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**

 + Provide Quality Systems expertise, guidance, coaching, and training to promote consistent, inspection-ready, and risk-based quality practices across the organization.
 + Partner with GxP functions and external service providers to establish quality expectations, resolve quality issues, implement compliant changes and CAPAs, and drive cross-functional quality improvement initiatives.
 + Promote a strong quality culture through effective stakeholder engagement, sound judgment, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* **General Responsibilities**

 + Act in accordance with Company policies, including the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and ensure applicable policies are understood and followed by direct reports, if any.
 + Other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 5–8+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other regulated industry, with demonstrated experience in Quality Systems, Quality Assurance, or compliance.
* Demonstrated experience with quality event management, including complex investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control.
* Strong working knowledge of QMS requirements, quality risk management principles, and applicable GxP regulations, including GMP and familiarity with GCP, GVP, and GLP.
* Experience with electronic Quality Management Systems such as Veeva Quality, MasterControl, or equivalent, including supporting system implementation, optimization, or maintenance.
* Experience developing, reviewing, and maintaining quality procedures, SOPs, metrics, and trending to support risk-based decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Experience supporting quality governance activities, regulatory inspections, internal or external audits, and inspection readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders while effectively navigating ambiguity and driving quality initiatives to completion.
* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance strategic judgment with a hands-on approach to execution.
* Excellent organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

Our Total Rewards program includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options, as well as a full range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, short-& long-term disability, accidental death & dismemberment, and life insurance programs, Employee Assistance Program, travel insurance, and retirement savings programs with company matching contributions.

Xenon encourages time to rest and re-charge through vacation, personal days, sick days, and an end-of-year company shutdown. Xenon highly values employee development and has an expanding Training, Learning & Development program, including a Tuition Assistance program for advanced degrees.

Compensation Range: $131.3K - $173.3K

card.description:
**POSITION**: Director, Quality Engineer 
 
**FULL-TIME/PART-TIME**: Full Time 
 
**LOCATION**:Bothell, WA

React Health is a fast-paced, growth-driven manufacturer and distributor of medical equipment, dedicated to supporting patients, caregivers, physicians, and healthcare providers. With a focus on respiratory and sleep health sectors, we offer a comprehensive range of products and services across acute care, non-acute care, and home medical equipment. By integrating manufacturing and distribution, React Health addresses the needs of both undiagnosed individuals and those requiring therapy after diagnosis, particularly within the sleep and respiratory care sectors. 
 
**GENERAL SUMMARY** 
The Director of Quality Engineering is a highly motivated, technically competent team builder who can establish and execute a strategic vision, multi-task in a fast-paced work environment, and deliver tangible results for the React Health facility for Class I and II products. The Director will lead and manage the Quality Engineering function to ensure operational compliance with government regulations (FDA-Quality System Regulation, and other applicable country specific regulations) and applicable standards. 
 
This position is responsible for leading and executing the Quality Engineering strategy for React Health. Responsibilities include managing the planning and implementation of the use, design and process (internal and external) risk management and integration; creation and implementation of corporate processes, process maps, procedures, and tools. 
 
A proven track record of work experience and success in Class II medical device manufacturing and distribution companies. Other essential skills include: the ability to recognize logistical problems and initiate appropriate solutions; problem-solving capability with a solid understanding of scientific data collection, analytics and management methods; and excellent interpersonal verbal and written communication skills. The position reports to the VP, Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs. 
 
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 15+ years of experience in leadership in quality/regulatory in FDA regulated company, including Supplier Quality, Design Quality and Process / Manufacturing Quality Engineering functions
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering
* 15+ years’ experience with ISO 13485, ISO 14971 Risk Management, FDA’s QSR for medical devices, Relevant applicable ISO Standards, MDR, Health Canada Regulations, and other International Regulations
* Change leadership, coaching, team development, managing multiple priorities, problem solving, Project Management
* CQE certification preferred

**Preferred Education**

* Master’s degree in Engineering

**Preferred Experience**

* Knowledge of QA document processes and systems, Design of Experiments (DOE), process capability studies, failure mode and effects analysis, and statistical tools including statistical process control.
* Knowledge of domestic and international regulatory requirements (i.e. FDA, GxPs, and ISO/EN standards).
* Excellent communications and interpersonal relationship skills including negotiating and relationship management with the ability to drive achievement of objectives.
* Proven ability to lead a diverse team of technicians and engineers.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well with people at all levels are essential.
* Able to demonstrate strong organizational and managerial skills.
* Capability of working independently, taking ownership for the management of processes, projects and timelines.
* Ability to effectively influence affiliates, regulatory agencies, and internal and external partners to ensure that business needs are met.
* Experience in leading and managing external audits and inspections
* Excellent attention to detail and project management skills.
* Excellent written/oral communication skills required. Must be able to work effectively with diverse groups of people.

**Physical Demands**

* Requires normal visual acuity and hearing.
* Typically, employees sit comfortably to do their work, interspersed by brief periods of standing, walking, bending, carrying papers and books, and extensive periods requiring the use of computer terminals to accomplish work objectives.
* Required to sit and use their hands and fingers to handle or feel and manipulate keys on a keyboard.
* Additional skills may be required to perform additional task(s) specific to work location, department or line of business.

**Working Conditions**

* Predominantly operates in an office environment. Some work (less than 5%) requires moving and lifting of heavy networking equipment.

**DUTIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** 
Each Employee consistently demonstrates the following essential functions:

* Member of site Senior management staff, providing representation for all Quality Engineering functions and personnel.
* Direct Quality Engineering functions (Supplier Quality, Design Quality and Process / Manufacturing Quality.
* Identify and lead continuous development and implementation of Quality Engineering strategy.
* Select and maintain best practice and compliant quality systems and processes in support of the global quality policy. Monitor technological trends such as emerging standards and new technology opportunities.
* Manage the planning and implementation of the Quality Engineering functions, including the creation and implementation of corporate processes, process maps, procedures, and tools in compliance with all applicable industry, local, national, and international regulatory requirements, and standards.
* Work closely with Marketing, Engineering, Manufacturing, Service, Suppliers, and other internal and external partners to ensure an effective, efficient, and well-established Quality Engineering processes.
* Provide direction to the team responsible for pre- and post-market quality engineering activities; use, design and internal and external process risk management such as FMEAs, test method validation, process improvements, non-conformance investigation and product disposition, corrective action, complaint analysis, etc.
* Gain cross-functional consensus, where possible, to establish new processes and implement effective change management.
* Continuously seek innovative ways to improve business productivity through the introduction of new quality system technologies, methods and controls.
* Establish product quality and process metrics that effectively measure and improve performance.
* Promote best practices to design, develop and manufacture products that will meet and exceed customers’ expectations.
* Manage needs for full-time or temporary Quality Engineering resources based on work level demands and budgetary constraints. Plan and execute staffing and compensation decisions.
* Develop and effectively manage operating, staffing, and projects budgets.
* Provide leadership to ensure the Quality Engineering organization attracts coaches and mentors and retains a knowledgeable and competent staff that is effectively organized to deliver high quality service to users, meet time commitments. Foster an environment which motivates the achievement of desired business results.
* Attends and participates in departmental meetings, attends seminars and training sessions necessary to maintain appropriate level of professional competence.
* Ensures all department compliance guidelines are met.
* Provides customer focused interactions.
* Performs all duties necessary for the department as per department policies and procedures.

card.description:
**What makes DHL great?** Our People! We know each employee’s individual contributions make us the #1 Express Delivery and Logistics Company in the world.

***Distinguished as No. 1 World’s Best Workplace™ by Great Place to Work and Fortune Magazine***

DHL Express is committed to maintaining an environment that empowers every team member to make the greatest possible impact on our business. Our culture is about personal commitment – to our business, to each other and to our global communities. DHL is dedicated to being a great place to work. In addition to competitive compensation packages, our employees enjoy a range of programs, services and benefits that bring the best to their personal lives.

**Start YOUR career with DHL today…**

The **Sr. Director Operations** is responsible for providing strategic input and leading the implementation of the Courier and Pick-up & Delivery strategy. This role ensures the safe, secure, timely, and accurate transportation and delivery of mail, parcels, small packages, and legal documents between locations, in alignment with business objectives, operational requirements, corporate guidelines, and policies.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Provide input to develop Couriers, Pick-up & Delivery operations strategy to deliver effective collection, transportation, and delivery of parcels while maintaining exceptional service quality and customer satisfaction.
* Plan, organize and control preparation of annual business plans, operational budgets, workforce planning, and resource allocation for delivery operations.
* Provide expertise, coaching, and leadership to frontline managers and supervisors to ensure execution of daily operational activities, achievement of performance targets, and development of future leaders.
* Manage and control service point operations to enable efficient collection, handling, and distribution of shipments while maintaining compliance with operational standards.
* Manage and control scheduling of transportation capacity, traffic volumes, route structures, and delivery resources to maximize productivity and service performance.
* Lead a workforce of more than 1,000 employees across multiple facilities, fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, safety, and operational excellence.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge and experience operating in unionized environments, including labor relations, contract interpretation, grievance resolution, workforce planning, and effective collaboration with union leadership.
* Oversee large independent contractor (IC) networks and transportation providers, ensuring contractual compliance, operational performance, cost management, and service reliability.
* Drive operational expense (OPEX) management through disciplined financial oversight, productivity initiatives, route optimization, and continuous improvement programs to achieve profitability objectives.
* Partner closely with Network Operations, Gateway Operations, Brokerage, Customs, Aviation, and Commercial teams to ensure seamless execution of customer commitments and network requirements.
* Deploy structured approaches to manage operational procedures including shipment processing, sorting, loading/unloading, documentation, scanning compliance, manifests, secure handling, and custody control.
* Implement reporting standards, performance metrics, and operational dashboards to provide visibility into service performance, cost drivers, productivity, and customer experience measures.
* Anticipate changes in customer demand, economic conditions, labor markets, and transportation trends to proactively adjust operational strategies and resource requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation, delivery, and customer service solutions through process redesign, technology implementation, and network optimization.
* Monitor operational performance and implement continuous improvement initiatives focused on service quality, productivity, safety, employee engagement, and cost control.
* Lead multiple delivery bases and service centers across geographically diverse markets, ensuring consistent execution of operational standards and business objectives.
* Champion safety, security, and compliance programs while maintaining adherence to company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Build strong relationships with key customers, local business leaders, and internal stakeholders to support growth initiatives and enhance the overall customer experience.
* Drive organizational change initiatives, workforce transformation efforts, and strategic projects across the region while maintaining high levels of employee engagement and operational performance.

**Skills/Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 8+ years of experience in operations and leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience in budgetary management and financial accountability.
* Strong background in business and operations management, including managing complex operational environments.
* Experience leading courier, Pick-up & Delivery, dock, and transportation operations.
* Proven ability to lead change management and operational improvement initiatives.
* Strong strategic planning and execution capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Proven leadership experience managing a department or business unit comprising multiple teams, including Managers and/or Team Leaders.
* Strong ability to lead, develop, and influence leaders and teams to achieve business and operational objectives.
* Experience establishing priorities, managing resources, and driving performance across multiple operational functions.
* Demonstrated ability to drive employee engagement, foster an inclusive and high-performing culture, and develop strategies that strengthen employee experience, retention, and organizational effectiveness.

**Employee Benefits & Incentives**

DHL Express benefits and incentive offerings are designed to reflect a substantial experience for both employees and their dependents during their career and life journey. The specifics will vary, but wherever you join and in whatever role, you'll find our benefits and rewards are among the best in the industry They include:

* Competitive Pay - Salary Range New Jersey $187,950- $250,600
* Bonus/Incentive Programs
* Retirement Savings – 401K with company match
* Medical, Dental, Vision, well-being programs
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Generous Paid Time Off – Starting at 4 Weeks (PT/FT)
* Paid Leave
* Employee Discount Program
* Employee Assistance & Work Life Program
* Outstanding training opportunities

*DHL is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status,* *or any other protected characteristic. The EEO is the Law poster is available here:* *https://www.eeoc.gov/employers/eeo-law-poster*

*We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to* *participate* *in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.* *Please contact us to request accommodation.*

card.description:
Reference

EPR009714

Posting Reference

Location

Remote, Remote, USA

Type

Full Time

Job Category

Operations

EthosEnergy O&M is recruiting for an Operations Director responsible for providing contract oversight and leadership to the Facility Managers in support of our Operations & Maintenance Contracts, as well as supporting the Business Development efforts for the Region. This individual is responsible for delivering a superior customer experience for both internal and external customers. Qualified candidates must have a minimum of (10)-ten years of power plant O&M experience with a minimum of (8)-eight years in a plant or corporate management position. Note extensive travel is required to meet with Plant Managers and Owner Representatives. This position reports to a VP of Operations and will be based remotely in the United States of America.

#### **Job Responsibilities**

* Ensure that assigned facilities are operated and maintained in a Safe and environmentally responsible manner.
* Provide supervision and leadership to Facility Managers and assigned staff. Provide coaching, training, and development opportunities to ensure appropriate skill sets are maintained. This includes the implementation and scheduling of training programs that cover operations, maintenance, safety, regulatory, and personal development areas.
* Fully understand contracts, O&M Agreements (OMA) and where applicable Long Term Service Agreements and Collective Bargaining Agreements for each Facility and ensure that the terms and activities of each agreement are followed and satisfied. Ensure all reports and information required under the terms of the OMA are prepared and submitted in a timely manner.
* Support EthosEnergy O&M policy development and ensure compliance with all company policies, procedures, and commercial commitments.
* Implement programs and activities that provide for a work environment that promotes effective goal accomplishment, productivity, and morale.
* Establish and maintain regular communications with Facility Owners to discuss plant performance and problem resolution. Schedule periodic meetings with Owners as per the OMA.
* Collect and / or review O&M Financial, HSE and Quality performance looking for trends that would require proactive implementation of countermeasures.
* Participate in EthosEnergy O&M Business Development meetings and activities. Help prepare O&M proposals for new and renewal projects and help identify potential business opportunities.
* Implement process improvements within EthosEnergy O&M, contribute to companywide improvements and help identify and track key performance indicators at both the plant and corporate levels.
* Special projects as assigned.

You will be responsible for improving performance, productivity, and efficiency through the implementation of effective methods and strategies. It's an exciting time to join the DP World team!

 

**About the Role**
------------------

**How you will contribute**

* Manage the daily activities of a logistics operation to maximize scheduling and delivery of commodities to the customer.
* Interface with customer to ensure smooth -coordination of scheduling and maximization of schedule adherence; provides input on local conditions, identifies needs and receives direction on real-time staffing increases or decreases.
* Enact contingency plans as needed; escalate and direct activities during system problems, disasters, etc.; identify potential problems, troubleshoot, escalate issues to local and senior management, and participate in post-mortem analysis of problems providing input for future process improvements.
* Review ongoing performance results to targets. Take corrective measures with authorization, escalate as needed
* Responsible for providing effective leadership to the Warehouse Managers and/or team, enforcing company standards, act as a role model.
* Other duties as assigned.
 

**Your Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or related field preferred.
* Progressive experience performing professional level operational and plant management duties; preferably in automotive or logistics industry.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex documents. Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries or complaints. Ability to write documents using original or innovative techniques or style. Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations on controversial or complex topics to top management and customer.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
* Proficient personal computer skills including electronic mail, record keeping, routine database activity, word processing, spreadsheet, graphics, etc.

**Compensation**

DP World offers exciting and challenging roles within a growing international organization. We strive to hire and develop the right people, locally and globally, stimulating personal growth and self-development within an informal atmosphere. We offer a market competitive compensation package.

 

**About DP World**

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 111,000 employees from 159 nationalities, spanning 77 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses - Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimising disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.

We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. Free minds and different perspectives are changing our world, and together we can change what’s possible.

The DP World family comprises of syncreon, Imperial and P&O.

**WE MAKE TRADE FLOW**

**TO CHANGE WHAT'S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE.**

 

**Nearest Major Market:** Albuquerque

Job Description:

**Position Summary:**

The Director of Operations is responsible for leading Hughes-Treitler operations to achieve business objectives related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and customer satisfaction. This hands-on leadership role provides strategic and day-to-day direction for manufacturing, materials, and operational excellence while ensuring the organization has the talent, capacity, processes, and resources required to support current demand and business growth. The Director establishes operating plans, drives accountability, builds organizational capability, and leads continuous improvement initiatives that improve performance, expand capacity, control costs, and strengthen customer responsiveness.

 
 

**Supervisory Responsibilties:**

The position has direct reports but must be able to work in partnership with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Production in support of the departmental objectives. 



**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop Operations teams to effectively support day-to-day execution, strategic business objectives, customer requirements, and growth plans.
* Establish operating strategies, objectives, budgets, capital requirements, material plans, labor requirements, and organizational priorities aligned with customer and business needs.
* Ensure the organization is structured and staffed with the talent, resources, and capabilities needed to meet customer quality, technical, delivery, and turnaround-time expectations.
* Partner with business leadership to achieve key performance indicators, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, throughput, backlog reduction, customer lead time, productivity, labor utilization, cost, and profitability.
* Lead the development and execution of the site Lean and Operational Excellence roadmap, using Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, TPM, SIOP and daily management practices to improve flow, yield, cycle time, productivity, and cost performance.
* Establish and monitor operating standards, performance metrics, and management routines that drive accountability, timely problem-solving, and sustained results.
* Drive capacity planning and expansion initiatives, including capital equipment, automation, facility, tooling, staffing, and process investments required to support business growth.
* Manage operating expenses and capital investments in accordance with approved budgets; identify and execute cost-reduction and productivity opportunities.
* Ensure effective planning and control of materials, inventory, suppliers, production schedules, and labor resources to support quality, cost, and delivery commitments.
* Collaborate with Quality, Engineering, Sales, Finance, and other cross-functional partners to resolve operational issues, support new product introductions, strengthen manufacturability, and meet customer requirements.
* Provide leadership for robust root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement activities related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and customer performance.
* Participate in the development and execution of the business strategy and translate strategic priorities into actionable operating plans and measurable objectives.
* Support commercial and customer-facing activities, including operational reviews, pricing and capacity analyses, customer visits, and performance presentations.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain operations talent through performance management, career development, succession planning, cross-training, and ongoing capability building.
* Foster a culture of accountability, employee engagement, collaboration, innovation, safety, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* Author annual performance reviews and develop continuing education and advancement paths for entire department.
* Demonstrate the ability and willingness to use AI tools appropriately to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and cost performance, including identifying suitable use cases and critically evaluating AI-generated outputs.
 

**Required Skills and Abilities:**

* Strong leadership, project management, analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations and continuous improvement initiatives in a complex manufacturing environment.
* Proficiency with Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to establish performance metrics, analyze operating data, prioritize competing demands, and drive accountability for results.
* Proven ability to lead change, manage multiple complex initiatives, and meet critical deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional interpersonal, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to build effective work relationships.
* Strong customer orientation and demonstrated ability to balance customer requirements with operational, financial, and organizational priorities.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure, exercise sound judgment, and maintain a hands-on leadership presence across the operation.
* Proficiency with enterprise resource planning and manufacturing systems; experience with SIOP or related planning processes preferred.
* Demonstrated history of successful change management and implementation of operational excellence improvements.
* Strong interpersonal, leadership and organizational skills and the ability to communicate with all levels of the organization from the production floor to the executive office.
* Willingness to work a flexible schedule and travel as needed to support business requirements.
 

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or another related technical discipline required; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing operations leadership experience in a low-volume/high-mix, build-to-order, or engineered-products environment; experience in aerospace, defense, metal-forming, precision machining, brazing, welding, or another highly regulated industry preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading salaried and hourly employees.
* Demonstrated experience leading Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, and continuous improvement programs with measurable results.
* Demonstrated experience driving operational planning, capital and capacity expansion, production and materials management, cost optimization, organizational improvements, and customer-facing operational reviews.

**Other**

* Due to the nature of Hughes-Treitler's programs and products, applicants must have the legal right to work in the US and additionally must be legally authorized to access export-controlled information and source code.

**Physical Requirements:**

* None

Salary Minimum: 200,000

Salary Maximum: 225,000

Incentive: No

**We are seeking a Home Health Operations Director to join our team, based in Englewood, Colorado.**

**Salary: $82-85K/YR +** **Quarterly Incentive Potential up to 20% of salary dependent on office success**

* Health, Dental, Vision Insurance

* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Company-Paid Life Insurance
* Paid Holidays, Paid Vacation Days, Paid Sick Days
* Easy access to state-of-the-art technology for electronic charting during point of care 24/7 Team Support for direct clinical and scheduling assistance

* Cell phone and mileage reimbursement
* Room for growth and advancement

Position Overview 
The Operations Director (hereafter referred to as “OD”) is responsible for managing and overseeing leadership and administrative functions of an Aveanna location. The OD collaborates with cross-functional teams including operations, clinical and business development ensuring annual business growth, patient care outcomes and financial objectives are met or exceeded. 
 
Serving as the leader of their respective branch team, the OD offers a dynamic work environment where individuals can contribute their expertise in either clinical or non-clinical capacities. The OD embodies Aveanna’s Core Values by building and strengthening relationships with patients, families, field staff, and referral sources while serving as an advocate and trusted mentor for their location team. The OD possesses strong written and verbal communication skills and assures the adoption of all branch-level processes and training standards. The OD ensures their location fully adheres to all Federal and State regulations governing home care agencies. 
 
Essential Job Functions 
Lead, develop, and support a high-performing team by recruiting qualified staff, ensuring timely performance evaluations, establishing and monitoring goals, promoting employee development, and maintaining consistent communication with supervisors and area/regional leadership. 
Build and strengthen relationships with patients, families, caregivers, referral partners, and business development teams by supporting effective introductions, periodic patient home visits, referral source assessments, satisfaction survey follow-up, and growth-oriented partnership objectives. 
Drive branch growth and operational performance by planning and implementing effective growth strategies. 
Successfully address the referral pipeline with urgency, and monitors referral management, admissions and start-of-care timelines. 
Oversee caregiver staffing, productivity, reporting deadlines, and overall service delivery. 
Manage financial and business performance by interpreting financial statements, activity reports, and other performance data; monitoring revenue, billing, collections, productivity, and expense control. 
Identify opportunities for cost mitigation and process improvement. 
Identify operational barriers, implement solutions that improve efficiency and branch outcomes, and partner with area and regional leadership to align priorities with business goals and organizational initiatives. 
Ensure operational readiness and compliance by maintaining adherence to company policies, payor requirements, and applicable federal and state regulations; 
Partner with clinical and operational leaders to address quality concerns; implement corrective actions and support continuous improvement. 
Monitor branch performance indicators to identify trends, mitigate risk, improve patient, caregiver, and business outcomes, and promote a culture of accountability, compliance, service excellence, and operational readiness. 
 
Requirements 
Minimum of an associate’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field. 
2-3 years’ management experience. 
Satisfies all state requirements, including background checks and any applicable required work authorization. 
 
Other Skills/Abilities 
Must be able to adhere to confidentiality standards and professional boundaries at all times. 
Ability to comfortably work in homes of families with limited resources. 
Quick-thinking and astute decision-making skills. 
Attention to detail. 
Time Management. 
Effective problem-solving and conflict resolution. 
Excellent organization and communication skills. 
Ability to remain calm and professional in stressful situations. 
Strong commitment to clinical excellence. 
 
Leadership skills 
Ability to train and supervise staff. 
 
Preferences 
4-Year College Degree preferred. 
Healthcare and/or pediatric home care experience a plus. 
 
Physical Requirements 
Must be able to speak, write, read and understand English. 
Must be able to travel as needed. 
Occasional lifting, carrying, pushing and pulling of 50 pounds. 
Prolonged walking, standing, bending, kneeling, reaching, twisting.

card.description:
Penn Aluminum International LLC

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

**Location:** Murphysboro, IL (On-Site)

**Who We Are**

Penn Aluminum is part of The Marmon Group, a Berkshire Hathaway Company. The Marmon Group comprises four autonomous companies consisting of 15 diverse, stand-alone business sectors and more than 185 independent manufacturing and service businesses. These businesses operate more than 350 manufacturing, distribution and service facilities, and employ more than 20,000 people worldwide.

Penn Aluminum is a premier manufacturer of aluminum drawn tubing and extruded shapes, providing high quality, engineered solutions to our customers. With strategically located production facilities, we are well positioned to support our customers throughout North America and beyond.

We are seeking a results-driven Director of Operations to lead our aluminum extrusion operations in Murphysboro, IL and Harlingen, TX. Our plants produce precision extruded and drawn tubing and custom profiles for Transportation, HVAC, Electrical, and Consumer Durables markets. Penn is investing over $60M in a state-of-the-art Murphysboro extrusion line that will double our tonnage output and open new markets, and this leader will be central to its success. The ideal candidate combines strong leadership, extrusion expertise, and a proven record of sustaining lean manufacturing across multiple sites.

**What You’ll Do**

* Team Leadership: Develop production managers, supervisors, and front-line employees at both sites, fostering an engaged, collaborative culture.
* Safety & Quality: Champion an uncompromising safety culture, ensure regulatory compliance, and maintain ISO and IATF quality systems and customer satisfaction.
* Multi-Site Operational Leadership: Provide strategic direction and oversight for safe, efficient, cost-effective production at Murphysboro and Harlingen, aligning standards, best practices, and performance metrics across both sites.
* Production Management: Oversee Murphysboro’s four extrusion presses, drawn benches, coil draw lines, cut-to-length, and fabrication, and Harlingen’s 2750T press with draw and heat treat processes.
* Lean & Continuous Improvement: Deploy and sustain lean methodologies (Kaizen, 5S, Value Stream Mapping, Six Sigma) to drive operational excellence.
* Strategic Planning: Partner with the President and executive team on long-term strategy, multi-site capacity planning, capital justification, and budget control.
* Resource Management: Optimize labor, materials, and equipment across both sites to maximize throughput, minimize waste, and improve OEE.
* Expansion Leadership: Lead the commissioning and ramp-up of the new $60M+ Murphysboro extrusion line, preparing people, processes, and supply chain to double tonnage output and grow in new markets

**What You’ll Need**

* Experience: 10+ years of progressive operations management, including at least five in aluminum extrusion; multi-site experience strongly preferred.
* Leadership: Proven ability to manage complex operations and large teams across multiple locations.
* Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of aluminum metallurgy, extrusion, and downstream operations (drawing, heat treating, cutting, fabrication).
* Lean Acumen: Extensive experience implementing and sustaining lean and continuous improvement. Six Sigma Green Belt strongly preferred.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or a related field preferred.
* Communication: Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
* Travel: Regular travel between Murphysboro and Harlingen.

**What You’ll Gain**

* Competitive salaried compensation
* Comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage)
* 401(k) with company matching
* Leadership development and career growth opportunities
* The ability to make a direct impact on safety, customer satisfaction, and operational performance
* A collaborative, results-driven work environment

Pay Range:

132,800.00 - 199,200.00

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that may include medical, dental, vision, 401k matching, and more!

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775) 784-1495 or jobs@unr.edu .

**Job Description**

The Department of Physics at the University of Nevada, Reno seeks applications for a Director of Operations and Infrastructure position. The position will support the growth and development of the Applied Sciences Institute for National Security (ASI), **located at the SAGE facility in Stead, NV.**

 

The Director of Operations and Infrastructure provides strategic and operational leadership for the Institute’s administrative and financial, facilities and infrastructure, and safety and security functions. The position is responsible for ensuring that the Institute’s personnel, facilities, financial resources, information systems, and operational practices effectively support its research, education, and workforce-development missions.

 

The Director of Operations and Infrastructure serves as the Institute’s principal operational liaison with University Facilities Services and other university offices on the development of new research capabilities, modernization of infrastructure, and maintenance of the Institute’s facilities and key experimental systems. The position represents the Institute in operational discussions with university leadership, government agencies, national laboratories, sponsors, contractors, and other external partners.

 

The Director of Operations and Infrastructure is also responsible for the safe and secure working practices within the facilities, ensuring staff are creating and following appropriate procedures, students are being trained appropriately and following procedures, and the facility and experimental capabilities meet or exceed requirements for safe and secure operating conditions.

card.title: Senior Director, Private Markets Operations & Experience
card.description:
**About You**

* Strategic Operator: You excel at translating complex investment strategies into actionable plans, scalable processes, and consistent execution.
* Collaborative Leader: You build strong relationships across teams, advisors, and external partners, creating alignment and accountability while delivering an exceptional client experience.
* Proactive Problem-Solver: You anticipate challenges, navigate complex fund operations with confidence, and bring sound judgment, attention to detail, and a solutions-oriented mindset to everything you do.

 

**The Role**

We’re looking for a strategic, results-driven professional to join our Private Markets team as Senior Director, Private Markets Operations & Experience. In this role, you’ll lead the operational execution of NorthRock’s private investment programs, overseeing fund formation, ongoing administration, program launches, and the advisor and client experience. As a key partner to the Executive Director, Private Capital Markets, you’ll help build the infrastructure, technology, service-provider relationships, and team capabilities needed to support continued growth. The ideal candidate thrives in a collaborative, evolving environment and is known for operational excellence, proactive leadership, and the ability to turn complex strategies into seamless execution.

 

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead end-to-end fund formation and launch activities, including legal entity formation, fund documentation, subscription materials, approvals, and operational readiness.
* Oversee ongoing private fund operations, coordinating subscription processing, capital activity, reporting, filings, and administrative requirements throughout the fund lifecycle.
* Partner with investment managers, fund administrators, legal counsel, tax professionals, and other service providers to ensure accurate, timely execution.
* Anticipate and resolve complex operational challenges, including rejected investment orders, subscription exceptions, and documentation or approval issues.
* Translate fund governing documents and investment program requirements into clear workflows, timelines, responsibilities, and operating procedures.
* Lead the rollout of private investment programs, partnering with advisor teams to develop communications, presentations, educational materials, and client engagement initiatives.
* Enhance the advisor and client experience by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve communications, and deliver consistent, high-quality service.
* Serve as a strategic operating partner to the Executive Director, aligning cross-functional teams, managing priorities, and ensuring accountability for key deliverables.
* Evaluate and implement technology solutions, operating systems, and service-provider partnerships that strengthen efficiency and support business growth.
* Help build and develop the private markets operations team, providing leadership, coaching, and guidance to support a scalable operating model.

 

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration, economics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 8–10 years of progressive experience in private markets operations, fund administration, or a related financial services function.
* Direct, hands-on experience forming and operating private investment funds, including private equity, private credit, or private real estate vehicles.
* Comprehensive understanding of the private fund lifecycle, including fund formation, subscriptions, investment operations, administration, and wind-down requirements.
* Experience interpreting fund governing documents and translating complex operational requirements into practical processes and execution plans.
* Proven ability to manage relationships with investment partners, fund administrators, legal counsel, tax professionals, and other external service providers.
* Demonstrated success resolving complex fund operational issues and leading cross-functional initiatives in a growing organization.
* Strong project management, organizational, and analytical skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to simplify complex investment information for advisors, clients, and internal stakeholders.
* Experience developing teams, coaching colleagues, and implementing process and technology improvements that enhance operational efficiency.
* Sound judgment, professionalism, discretion, and a commitment to delivering an exceptional advisor and client experience.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Successful completion of a credit and criminal background check is required.

 

**Compensation & Benefits**

The estimated base salary range for this role is $183,000 – $251,000 per year. Compensation is based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographical work location.

 

**About NorthRock Partners**

At NorthRock Partners, we help people reach their potential through impactful advice. Our Personal Office® model delivers integrated financial and lifestyle guidance tailored to each client’s unique goals.

 

NorthRock Partners is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation throughout the application and employment process. For assistance, contact PeopleTeam@NorthRockPartners.com.

card.description:
**Senior Manager of Operations**

**Scottsdale Mint | Casper, Wyoming** 
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Salaried

**Company Summary**

Founded in 2008, Scottsdale Mint is a U.S.-based precious metals manufacturer recognized globally for its innovation, quality, and American craftsmanship. As a privately held producer of premium gold, silver, and platinum bullion, the company serves sovereign nations, central banks, Fortune 500 companies, industrial clients, and authorized distributors worldwide.

Operating from its advanced manufacturing facility in Casper, Wyoming, Scottsdale Mint specializes in high-purity bullion, legal-tender coin programs, and custom-branded precious metal products. The company combines artistic design, scientific precision, and advanced minting technology to deliver products recognized for their quality, detail, and authenticity.

**Position Summary**

The Senior Manager of Operations is responsible for overseeing the daily performance and overall effectiveness of Scottsdale Mint's Coining, Melting, CNC Machining, and Die Manufacturing departments. This position provides leadership and direction to approximately 30 employees, ensuring manufacturing operations are safe, efficient, productive, and aligned with company objectives.

The successful candidate will be a visible, hands-on leader capable of managing multiple manufacturing functions, developing departmental supervisors, establishing accountability, and improving operational performance while supporting current production requirements and future manufacturing growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Manufacturing & Operations Management**

* Oversee daily operations and production performance across Coining, Melting, CNC Machining, and Die Manufacturing.
* Establish departmental priorities, production goals, and performance expectations in coordination with senior management.
* Coordinate labor, equipment, and resources to maximize productivity, throughput, and manufacturing capacity.
* Monitor production schedules and workflow, identifying bottlenecks and implementing solutions to improve output and efficiency.
* Coordinate with Planning & Inventory Control, Fulfillment, Maintenance, Marketing, and other departments to support production requirements and company objectives.
* Develop, monitor, and report on departmental KPIs to optimize workforce utilization and ensure production schedule adherence.

**2. Leadership & Workforce Management**

* Provide leadership, direction, and accountability to departmental supervisors and employees.
* Manage staffing levels, scheduling, attendance, and labor allocation to meet production requirements.
* Establish clear expectations for employee performance, productivity, communication, and workplace conduct.
* Conduct performance reviews, address personnel matters, and establish development objectives for direct reports.
* Develop supervisory capabilities and ensure employees receive appropriate training to perform their responsibilities effectively.
* Foster a professional work environment emphasizing teamwork, accountability, ownership, and employee development.

**3. Safety, Compliance & Operational Excellence**

* Maintain consistent operating standards, manufacturing procedures, and a strong safety culture across all assigned departments.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, company safety policies, and applicable workplace requirements.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including production output, labor efficiency, downtime, quality, and schedule attainment.
* Evaluate manufacturing processes to identify safety concerns, operational inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Promote proper equipment operation, preventative maintenance, housekeeping, and organization throughout manufacturing areas.
* Ensure operational and safety issues are addressed promptly and corrective actions are implemented.
* Communicate departmental performance, challenges, and improvement initiatives to senior management.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5–7 years of progressive manufacturing supervisory or management experience, preferably overseeing multiple departments.
* Experience managing production teams and workforces of approximately 25–50 employees preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Management, or a related discipline preferred; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production workflows, labor management, and operational efficiency.
* Working knowledge of OSHA regulations and manufacturing safety requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to manage production objectives, develop supervisors, and hold employees accountable for performance.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and manufacturing-related reporting systems.

**Position Expectations**

The Senior Manager of Operations is expected to take ownership of the overall performance of the assigned manufacturing departments. This individual must provide consistent leadership, establish clear priorities, and ensure departmental supervisors are effectively managing their teams and achieving established objectives.

Success will be measured by the ability to meet production goals, maintain safe and efficient operations, effectively manage workforce resources, improve manufacturing performance, and develop a capable and accountable team.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
